title: Everything that happens before your <hl>first question</hl>
intro: Eight steps stand between you and the interview. Here's exactly what each one involves so there are no surprises on the day.

download.title: Download the desktop app
download.desc: Interviews run in the LetsHyre desktop app, which keeps the session secure. <dl>Download the app</dl> and install it on your Windows computer.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.desc: Open the app and sign in with your candidate account. New to LetsHyre? <reg>Create an account</reg> first. It holds your interview slots, profile photo and results.

dashboard.title: Open your dashboard
dashboard.desc: Your dashboard shows your profile and the interview slots open to you. When you click Take Interview, the app runs a quick security check before anything else opens.

clearEnv.title: Close other apps
clearEnv.desc: The security check looks for apps that could get in the way of a fair interview, such as web browsers, screen recorders, AI assistants and video-call tools. Close anything it flags to continue.
clearEnv.tip: Close every other app before you click Take Interview.

permissions.title: Allow camera, microphone and screen access
permissions.desc: The app asks for your microphone, camera and screen. It needs all three to supervise the interview, so allow each one when your computer asks.

verifyId.title: Verify your identity
verifyId.desc: Read a short statement aloud to register your voice, then let the camera take a live photo. We compare it with the profile photo on your account.
verifyId.tip: Face the camera in a well-lit room.

chooseRole.title: Choose your role
chooseRole.desc: Pick the position you're interviewing for. You can keep the role from your onboarding, or choose another slot if more than one is open to you.

begin.title: Begin your interview
begin.desc: The interview opens full screen with screen recording on. Answer each question within its time limit. You can move between questions until the session timer runs out.

requirements.title: Before you start
requirements.description: Check these before the day of your interview.

computer.title: A Windows computer
computer.desc: The interview runs in the LetsHyre desktop app. It can't be taken on a phone or tablet.

camera.title: A working camera
camera.desc: It takes your verification photo and stays on while you answer.

microphone.title: A microphone
microphone.desc: Used for voice registration and for your spoken answers.

internet.title: A stable internet connection
internet.desc: Your answers and screen recording are uploaded during the session.

room.title: A quiet, well-lit room
room.desc: Face the light so the camera sees you clearly, and keep background noise low.

privacy.title: What we record and why
privacy.body: During the interview we record your camera, microphone and screen. Employers who unlock your profile can watch the recording with your AI scorecard. Your live photo is compared with your profile photo to confirm it's you. The <pp>privacy policy</pp> has the details.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.desc: Download the desktop app, sign in, and click Take Interview when you're ready.
